item_data.name: The Grimoire
item_data.description:
A Grimoire was never merely just a book. It was a relic. A covenant. Written in ink that did not wash clean. 

These nails were made in the same spirit. I wanted something that would stop you mid-scroll. Something Iconic. Something that the moment you saw it, you just knew. 

These nails use a translucent base pale as candlelight through cathedral glass, marked by two lines of deep crimson that rise like a gothic arch and meet at the tip like a blade laid upon an altar. At the crown of each nail, a 3D sculpted cross in gunmetal and chrome. Hand-placed. Intentional. Unmistakably ours. 

But underneath of all of that, this set was made as a quiet signal. For the ones who have always lived a little sideways from the world. The alt girls. The dark romantics. The ones who paint their nails like armor. This is me saying I see you. I'm here too. This was made for you. 

Because it was. 

Choose your nail shape:

Stiletto - sharp and Unapologetic.

Coffin - Beautiful in the finite. 

Almond - Soft-spoken with darkness behind the eyes

Square - Deliberate and grounded

Squoval - For those who never quite fit in one category. 

Standard sizing for immediate wear. Custom fitted if you want them made exactly for your hand - because something this intentional deserves to fit like it was cast from you directly.

The Grimoire Set
Cast in Darkness. Worn with intention.

item_data.name: Noir et Blanc — The Ribbon Collection
item_data.description:
Noir et blanc. Black and white — the oldest argument there is, and the most beautiful. This set doesn't choose a side; it wears both like a ribbon tied at the throat. A bright porcelain base crossed with inkstroke stripes, finished in liquid chrome and crowned with a single sculpted bow. Demure and dangerous in the same breath — the kind of soft that has teeth. The first of the Ribbon Collection, for those who like their elegance with something tied round its neck.

Tied in contrast. Worn like a confession.

item_data.name: La Fraise — Jardin Collection
item_data.description:
La fraise. The strawberry — sweetest thing in the garden, and the first to be devoured. This is the opening bloom of the Jardin Collection, where everything pretty hides a little rot beneath it. A sculpted strawberry sits ripe at the tip, dotted in white seed and fed by a single green leaf — fruit rendered like a still life left one day too long. Sweet, saturated, faintly sinful. For the ones who reach for the forbidden one on purpose.

Grown in the garden. Worn without apology.

item_data.name: Leviathan x Benthic
item_data.description:
Leviathan. The thing the old maps warned you about, drawn in the margins where the water goes black. This set descends — deep green bleeding into abyssal black, textured like the hide of something vast and patient in the cold. A single gem catches the light like an eye opening in the dark. From the Benthic depths, where pressure makes monsters of us all. For those who were never afraid of what's down there. They were curious.

Risen from the deep. Worn like a warning.

item_data.name: The Specter
item_data.description:
The Specter. Not every haunting wears chains. Some are quiet — a presence at the edge of the room, gone when you turn to look. This set is restraint made beautiful: clean matte white, no charm, no noise, only the cold elegance of something not quite of this world. Minimal. Ghostly. Unforgettable for what it withholds. For those who don't need to be loud to be felt.

Seen for a moment. Remembered far longer.

item_data.name: The Fool's Decree
item_data.description:
The Fool's Decree. The jester was the only one in the court who could tell the king the truth — and live. This set is that license made visible: a harlequin diamond pattern in dramatic contrast, hung with tiny bells that announce you before you speak. Playful and merciless in equal measure. For the ones who laugh at what they're supposed to fear.

The fool speaks last. And laughing.

item_data.name: Both Altars
item_data.description:
Both Altars. Some hearts were never built to kneel at just one. This set is devotion in two directions at once — a deep matte base scattered with a cascade of 3D hearts in rose, violet, and blue, the colors of those who love without choosing a side. Two truths held in the same hand, and no apology owed for either. Inverted, doubled, refusing the line someone else drew. For the ones who go both ways and were told it made them less — it never did. It made you whole.

Worn in both lights. Devoted twice over.
